Too-long paragraph fixture

A paragraph whose text sent to the service is over 5000 characters is not translated; a short grey note is written at its end instead and the panel counts it as skipped. Expected total after translating the page: 6 (sections 1, 4 twice, 5, 6 and 8's first paragraph).

1. A plain long paragraph

Expected: a grey note at the end of the paragraph, the text itself untouched. Counts 1.

2. A short paragraph around a huge inline code

The command is and nothing more.

The 6000 characters in the inline code are not sent. Expected: translated like any short paragraph, no note. Counts 0.

3. Noise: a long URL and a long number on their own

Expected: neither is translated and neither gets a note (they are noise, not "too long"). Counts 0.

4. Two long texts in one block, split by a block child

A short block between the two long texts.

Expected: the short block is translated and each long text gets its own note: two notes. Counts 2.

5. Long text directly inside a flex container

No <p> around the text. Expected: one note, laid out inline (its element carries data-et-inline). Counts 1.

6. A long paragraph on a dark background

Expected: the note is clearly readable on the dark background (its element carries data-et-host="dark"). Counts 1.

7. Translation only

Switch to translation only with section 1 on screen. Expected: the long paragraph stays visible, is not hidden and has no data-et-only; the note stays. Switch back to bilingual: nothing changes. Counts 0 more.

8. Content that changes

Starts with one long paragraph (counts 1). Shorten only changes that first paragraph and can be clicked again; added paragraphs stay long. Expected: after Shorten its note goes away, the paragraph is translated and the total becomes 5. After Add a long paragraph there is one more note and the total becomes 6; adding sends no request, so the translation stays "done". The panel does not refresh itself: close and reopen it to read the new count (known limit, see docs/plans/skipped-count.md).
